items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: I remember seeing Celestine about, I saw somebody, I saw Celestine about a year before he died... I remember he used to come to Slidell and play for us with Manuel and them.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, she still does that. Every year. Oh yeah, she still does that.

Oh she knows who I was doing. I gave a lot of dances in life, and I gave a lot of lawn parters. And I made pretty good on them, you know. And I think, I wouldn't say if I was a little younger, I could really, now I could understand giving them, but I just wouldn't have anybody to go in with me, you know, to give them, you know. And you really had such a different opportunity. I don't know, the people was a lot different in some respects. And then you'd get a police, you could choose the police you want at the…
